title: cyclophyllum rectinervium
intro: Cyclophyllum rectinervium, commonly known as the "Wai" tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, showcasing its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyclophyllum rectinervium include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it a viable treatment option for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
